name: Guild Heighliner
text:
[Sentinel]
As you play this unit, you may defeat any number of friendly Spice tokens. It costs [1] less for each Spice token defeated this way.
[When Played:] Search the top 8 cards of your deck for any number of ground units with a combined cost of [#8] or less and play them for free. They gain [Ambush] for this phase.
